text_simplified: Daughters are the beloved of hearts and the joy of souls, and raising them with a sound Islamic upbringing fulfills a parent's duty and brings happiness in this world and the Hereafter. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever cares for two girls until they reach maturity will come on the Day of Resurrection—he and I" and he joined his fingers (Sahih Muslim 2631). And regarding the woman who preferred her two daughters over herself with a single date, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, Allah has made Paradise obligatory for her because of it, or has freed her from the Fire because of it" (Sahih Muslim 2630). Thus, Islamic law strongly encourages kindness toward daughters and patience in raising them.
